trust_decision.summary: CachedClient.Get resolves a tag to a digest, cosign-verifies that digest, then fetches and caches the image by the mutable tag, so the bytes parsed and cached under the verified digest's key need not be the verified image.

landing_point.why: Summary names xpkg.CachedClient and the verify-then-fetch gap; Get is the only method that verifies and fetches, and the Fetch call uses parsedResolvedRef (tag) while Validate uses the digest ref built at line 321.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API xpkg.(*CachedClient).Get (Client interface, pkg/xpkg/client.go:46), called by Crossplane package manager on install/upgrade

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Only one Fetcher.Fetch call in the tree (pkg/xpkg/client.go:328); K8sFetcher.Fetch (pkg/xpkg/fetch.go:132-148) just passes the ref to remote.Image.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Cache-hit path skips verification (pkg/xpkg/client.go:277-300) and is documented as an intended trade-off (pkg/xpkg/client.go:306-315), so a solver could argue cache trust is out of scope; but the cache key is the Head digest, so once the fetch is digest-pinned there is no remaining route.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Tag-based installs must keep working, with and without an ImageConfig verification policy, including ImageConfig path rewrites and pull secrets; rejecting tag refs or disabling the cache would be over-broad.

O7_producer.where: pkg/xpkg/client.go:342-345 stores fetched bytes under cacheKey derived from the verified digest (pkg/xpkg/client.go:275); later Gets read it without verification (pkg/xpkg/client.go:277-300)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A ListVersions-then-Get or dependency-resolution helper that resolves the newest tag and fetches by tag after verifying the digest
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ListVersions already returns tags for callers that then call Get with a tag; a convenience helper resolving and fetching in one step would plausibly repeat the tag fetch.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second fetch path (e.g. a Head-fallback that returns the image from remote.Get, or a layer/descriptor fetch for ExtractPackageYAML) that uses the tag rather than the verified digest
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Head already falls back to a GET by the same ref; a maintainer optimising to one round-trip could reuse that descriptor's image, reintroducing a tag-based fetch in another file.

O9_family: integrity verification / TOCTOU (verify one artifact, use another by mutable reference)

O10_build.toolchain: Go modules (go.mod), nix flake for CI (nix/checks.nix)
O10_build.project_tests: pkg/xpkg/client_test.go table tests for CachedClient.Get with MockFetcher/MockConfigStore (pkg/xpkg/client_test.go:44-61); MockFetch receives the name.Reference so a hidden test can assert it is a digest.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Fetch by parsedResolvedRef.Context().Digest(digest) (correct and complete here), or alternatively compare img.Digest() to the verified digest after fetch.

out_of_scope_notes: Verification policy is matched on the rewritten ref (pkg/xpkg/client.go:316) while rewrite is matched on the original ref (pkg/xpkg/client.go:234); not pursued.
